programme.title: LaLiga Santander: Real Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Uno de los platos fuertes de la temporada se sirve en el Bernabéu en la novena jornada de campeonato. Real Madrid y Barcelona, igualados al frente de la tabla, se juegan el liderato. El Clásico llega tras una semana de Champions que ha dejado a los culés tocados.

programme.title: Especial El Clásico
programme.desc: Toda la información relacionada con el partido de la 35ª jornada de LaLiga que enfrenta a Barcelona y Real Madrid. El Clásico del Lluís Companys atraerá las miradas de todo el mundo del fútbol y será clave en el desenlace de LaLiga.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Barcelona - Real Madrid
programme.desc: ¡Llega ElClásico! Por primera vez en la historia, el FC Barcelona se enfrenta al Real Madrid en el Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys. Los azulgranas y los merengues luchan por hacerse con el liderato de LALIGA EA SPORTS.

programme.title: Courtois La vuelta del número 1: La gran final
programme.desc: Courtois celebra su 32 cumpleaños en un fin de semana repleto de emociones y sorpresas. El Real Madrid firma su pase a la final de la Champions. En el horizonte el gran sueño de volver a alzarse campeón y demostrar que el número 1 ha vuelto.

programme.title: Revelado - Lopetegui
programme.desc: Julen Lopetegui se sincera en Revelado, un espacio de DAZN en el que conocemos el lado más personal de los protagonistas.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Comienzo
programme.desc: En 2003, El Manchester United de Sir Alex Ferguson recibió en Old Trafford al Oporto de José Mourinho en un tenso partido de octavos de final de la UEFA Champions League. Un encuentro que desempeñaría un papel clave en la carrera de uno de los entrenadores más exitosos de la historia.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho
programme.desc: Vivimos el segundo episodio del Making Off de José Mourinho, recientemente destituido como técnico del Tottenham.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Real Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Llega uno de los momentos más esperados de la temporada. Tras exhibirse ambos en Champions, el Clásico mide a los dos grandes aspirantes al título liguero. El Real Madrid cuenta con el Bernabéu en ebullición; el Barcelona, con tres puntos de ventaja en la tabla.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Mago
programme.desc: José Mourinho fue nombrado entrenador del Real Madrid con una complicada misión: detener al FC Barcelona de Pep Guardiola. En abril de 2012, el equipo blanco viajó al Camp Nou para jugar el Clásico sabiendo que sólo una derrota podía impedirles ganar el título de Liga.

programme.title: Linea Diletta
programme.desc: La periodista italiana Diletta Leotta conversa con personalidades del mundo del fútbol. En esta ocasión, el técnico del Real Madrid, Carlo Ancelotti, responde a sus preguntas, en una charla en la que repasa su carrera y su presente como técnico blanco.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Real Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Nuevo episodio en la rivalidad que marca el paso en LaLiga. Real Madrid y Barcelona se miden en el Bernabéu con el liderato en juego. Los blancos, con dos puntos de ventaja, pueden poner tierra de por medio. Los culés han salido airosos en los últimos Clásicos.

programme.title: Especiales LaLiga fin de temporada
programme.desc: LaLiga EA Sports ha finalizado otro curso plagado de historias y de fútbol. El campeonato español de la regularidad deja relatos para el recuerdo y héroes que se han convertido en los protagonistas de la temporada.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: Simeone. Revelado
programme.desc: El entrenador argentino del Atlético de Madrid se ha convertido en una pieza clave para plantar batalla al Real Madrid y FC Barcelona. Descubre su lado más personal en esta entrevista con DAZN.

programme.title: OR7GEN
programme.desc: David Villa hace un viaje por sus orígenes futbolísticos y los de muchos otros jugadores. El máximo goleador histórico de la Selección visita las canteras de cuatro equipos en los que él dejó su impronta. Le acompañan iconos como Torres, Xavi o Albelda.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Barcelona
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: Dorsal 12
programme.desc: ''Dorsal 12'' es una excusa para contar la vida a través del fútbol. Un programa que no se centra en el balón, sino en lo que le rodea. Rafael Escrig viaja por los estadios de LaLiga para contar las historias humanas más impactantes del fútbol español.

programme.title: Iconos: Antoine Griezmann
programme.sub-title: Antoine Griezmann, el reino del Principito
programme.desc: DAZN se sienta con varios de los protagonistas más importantes de la temporada en LaLiga EA Sports, empezando con Antoine Griezmann, delantero del Atlético de Madrid.

programme.title: LALIGA VS
programme.desc: LALIGA VS es un proyecto de LALIGA y los clubes que tiene el objetivo de erradicar el odio dentro y fuera del fútbol, promoviendo una sociedad respetuosa e inclusiva en todos sus ámbitos. Esta plataforma busca inspirar y sensibilizar a los aficionados.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Argentina - Argelia
programme.desc: El Mundial más grande de la historia ya está aquí. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA cuenta por primera vez con 48 equipos en busca de la gloria. Estados Unidos, México y Canadá se convierten en el epicentro del planeta fútbol del 11 de junio al 19 de julio.

programme.title: Maradona: The Fall
programme.desc: En el Mundial de 1994, saltó el escándalo. Diego Maradona, icono del fútbol, dio positivo en un control antidoping y fue expulsado de la selección argentina. Este trabajo documental repasa el momento más duro en la carrera futbolística del astro de Lanús.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Sharyn Alfonsi, Anderson Cooper, Steve Kroft, Lara Logan, Norah O'Donnell, Scott Pelley, Charlie Rose, Lesley Stahl, Jon Wertheim, Oprah Winfrey and Bill Whitaker.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.

programme.title: Corrupt Crimes
programme.desc: True-crime series are a staple of the TV landscape. "Corrupt Crimes" analyzes recent criminal cases through a combination of expert testimony and dramatic storytelling. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick.

programme.title: It Takes a Killer
programme.desc: Some of the world's most notorious murders are the subject of "It Takes a Killer," which investigates the crimes from the perspective of the killers, trying to get inside their minds and determine their motives. Leading homicide investigators and experts from such agencies as the FBI and Scotland Yard take a look at the evidence pulled from crime scenes and profile the killer's behavior to try to piece together the details of each murder, explaining when, why and how each criminal committed the crime. For the wannabe detectives watching the show, the experts also reveal how the crime was solved -- which often requires authorities to think like a killer.

programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Two Girls and a Sailor
programme.desc: After a successful nightclub performance, singer Patsy (June Allyson) and her gold digger sister Jean (Gloria DeHaven) hold a private show for servicemen, after which both become smitten with a sailor named Johnny (Van Johnson). Unexpectedly, Patsy and Jean receive a huge anonymous donation, which they use to refashion an abandoned warehouse into a canteen. As they continue working on their new business, they try to determine who their benefactor was, all the while competing for Johnny's love.

programme.title: Meet the People
programme.desc: While at a war bond rally in a Delaware shipyard, starry-eyed welder Swanee Swanson (Dick Powell) becomes infatuated with Broadway star Julie Hampton (Lucille Ball). Swanee reveals to Julie that he has written a musical, "Meet the People," that celebrates the working class. An impressed Julie pitches the idea to her producer. But when the play is transformed into a flashy Broadway extravaganza, the idealistic Swanee is left feeling bitter, and his trust for Julia is tarnished.

programme.title: Two Sisters From Boston
programme.desc: Boston socialite Abigail Chandler (Kathryn Grayson) dreams of singing with the New York Metropolitan Opera. After her aunt and uncle kindly pay for her to go to New York for voice lessons, Abigail secretly takes a job singing at a beer hall in the Bowery in order to pay for the lessons. Abigail's stuffy sister, Martha (June Allyson), remains after a family visit to keep an eye on her, and, instead of being shocked by Abigail's secret performing life, she ends up enthusiastically joining her.

programme.title: The Secret Heart
programme.desc: Penny Addams (June Allyson) lives in a constant state of depression stemming from the trauma of her father's death when she was just a young girl. Her brother, Chase (Robert Sterling), and stepmother, Lee (Claudette Colbert), work to help Penny process her grief through psychotherapy and revisiting their past, but only the revelation of long-buried family secrets -- including her mother's secret lover and the true nature of her father's death -- can bring Penny out of her intense despair.

programme.title: Good News
programme.desc: Tommy (Peter Lawford) is Tait College's quarterback and the biggest heartthrob on campus; unfortunately, his preoccupations with football and girls leave little time for studying. With an important game on the horizon, Tommy flunks a test. The college refuses to let Tommy play unless he retakes the test and gets a decent grade. Bookish student Connie (June Allyson) is enlisted to help; when they begin to hit it off, another seductive Tait coed grows jealous and decides to butt in.

programme.title: The Three Musketeers

After clashing with three of the king's musketeers, Athos (Van Heflin), Porthos (Gig Young) and Aramis, he joins them in fighting the forces of corrupt Richelieu (Vincent Price). When Richelieu attempts to undermine the throne and fan the flames of war, D'Artagnan and the musketeers must thwart his plans.

programme.title: The Opposite Sex

However, when she hears that gold-digging Crystal is making Steve unhappy, Kay resolves to get her husband back.

Mac and Pearl eventually marry, but she worries whenever he sets foot in a plane -- especially when he's chosen as a test pilot for the new Sabre jet.

programme.title: Battle Circus
programme.desc: In an Army field hospital during the Korean War, a tempestuous relationship develops between an arrogant, cynical, brilliant military surgeon named Maj. Jed Webbe and a nurse, Lt. However, the harsh reality of war and the couple's commitment to their military duties complicates the love affair.
